lines.t: Giving her the benefit of the doubt, I went to the meeting spot to see the person who claimed to be Estelle.
Vermont Plaza
You actually came?
I'm Estelle. Nice to meet you.
Oh. You really are Estelle, aren't you?
Even on my way here, I was sure you'd be a fake.
And what were you going to do if I was?
Extort enough money out of you to compensate for wasting my time.
You are just as I heard. Ahaha!
...Staring so intently at someone right in front of you makes me a little embarrassed.
Well, everyone looks at me with those eyes anyway!
You don't look embarrassed at all! Aren't you actually enjoying it?!
Anyway... even a celebrity like you cares about how other people look at you?
Of course. And besides, in this city, you're just as famous as I am, aren't you?
As the guy who broke out of a prison where you only had to stay for a single day!
I didn't want to be remembered for that kind of infamy...
Sigh... Anyway, why did you call me out here? Do you have a request for me or something?
Hmm, it's not that, but... about an hour ago, were you perhaps being chased by the police?
Running down the main avenue butt naked...
Just so you know, it's not like I'm an exhibitionist or anything!
A while back, I received a letter from some organization.
According to the letter, anyone who demonstrates 'true courage'...
...would be granted entry to a certain Secret Party.
So you pulled a crazy stunt like that all because of a childish letter...
How could something like that count as true courage?
That doesn't explain it at all. What's the real reason?
The real reason is simple. '<bouten>Secret Party</bouten>.'
I was curious. It's bound to be amazing.
You're either an interesting guy, or a crazy exhibitionist.
I told you I'm not.
Anyway, why did you call me out here?
Famous actress or not, if you're just trying to waste my time, pay me—
I'll tell you the real reason later. For now... let's just say I got curious.
...That doesn't explain anything. Seriously, pay—
...Police officers? Guess you haven't thrown off your pursuers yet?
Damn it... Those donut munchers are such a pain...
Fufu... Just being seen with you in a situation like this would make terrible gossip, wouldn't it?
I parked my car right next to us, so let's get out of here first.
...W-Wait a second. Didn't your last movie have a high-speed chase scene—
Urgh... Pull over for a second...
I-I'm seriously gonna die...
Secluded Back Alley
Uuuugh... How on earth did you learn to drive?!
What's the point of having a luxury car if your driving is this... Urgh...!
Ahaha, sorry! It's not my car, so delicate control is harder than I thought.
But we didn't get caught, right? So isn't that all that matters?
Easy for you to say... Blech...
Fufu, despite your infamous reputation, you get motion sick easily, huh?
Still, thanks for coming out today! Thanks to you, my curiosity is satisfied.
Well, I'm heading off! See you next time.
Gah, selfish from start to finish...
Hey!! Are you really just leaving me here alone?!!

lines.t: Fancy Restaurant
Over here! Over here!
This place looks way pricier than I expected.
Don't worry about the prices! I come here all the time.
To a place this noticeable and crowded...?
For a <bouten>celebrity</bouten>, this is a piece of cake!
Anyway, let's order first.
I ordered a bunch of expensive-looking dishes and ate every single one.
You have a great appetite. Want me to order more?
Nah, I'm full. That's probably the best meal I've had in a while...
So, what's your business with me today?
Last time and this time too, you contacted me completely out of the blue.
Well, you know, I have various reasons...
I was also curious about how that '<bouten>Secret Party</bouten>' turned out...
Ah. That? I actually managed to get an invitation.
Oho... Really? What kind of invitation was it?
Just a fancy-looking invitation. The contents were pretty ordinary, just the time and place.
Something smells fishy. The condition for getting the invitation in the first place is suspicious.
Are you really going to a party like that?
What do you mean? Since I've come this far, I have to check out what's so secret about it.
And why do you care anyway? I'm the one going.
Because it sounds dangerous!
Like the police waiting for you there, or someone kidnapping you.
Your driving is scarier than getting kidnapped.
Hey, I said I was sorry! I even bought you dinner, are you gonna keep bringing that up?
Tch.
Anyway, I'm going to the party.
Even though it might be dangerous?
Yeah.
Why?
Because it looks fun.
What's with the sudden silence?
You know... Sometimes I wish I could live like you.
There you go saying weird things again...
Why would a celebrity like you want to experience bottom-of-the-barrel life like mine?
Being famous is great, but sometimes I want to enjoy my own freedom.
Am I being too greedy?
...? Isn't that just a natural human desire?
Who doesn't like being free?
Mmm...

From what I see,
you care way too much about what other people think.
I-Is that so? Do I really look like that? Why?
Well, you...
You're constantly acting out 'me, the greatest celebrity in the world.'
How did you...
The plaza where everyone can see you. Expensive cars. Expensive food.
Meeting in a plaza when we could've met in a café...
Insisting on driving a top-of-the-line luxury car that isn't even yours...
And now, even a pricey restaurant like this.
No matter how famous an actress you are, you're not rich on the level of Head Maid or Bunny Gloria.
Why are you so obsessed with maintaining that 'perfect celebrity' image?
Th-That's...
Phew... Truth is, I really did contact you because I have a request.
There's a psychological problem I was hoping you could solve...
...Alright, let's hear it.
Every single day, countless eyes are fixed on me.
And every time I feel those eyes on me... I get goosebumps all over, thinking I have to live up to their expectations.
I tried meditation, saw psychiatrists, took medication... but nothing worked at all.
...So why bring that problem to me?
...Because you're a Fixer? Because you're someone who accomplishes things others can't?
...That reason is so absurd I can only laugh.
Don't laugh... I'm serious about this.
Well, laughing at someone's serious troubles isn't something a decent person should do.
Hmm... Okay. I thought of a way.
Already?! What is it? How??
Come with me to that 'Secret' Party.
What? I didn't get an invitation.
And why would I go to a suspicious place like that...?
You need the 'courage to endure people's gaze', don't you?
The 'courage to go to the party' will be your first step.
But...
Ah. My manager is calling me...!
Looks like she found out I snuck away.
Sorry! I have to go first!
Was your meal satisfactory? I can assist with your bill now.
...Huh?
...Did the person who just left not pay?
Nope, she did not pay.
However, I noticed you finished your meal a while ago, and since your companion has departed...
I bolted out of the restaurant at full speed.

lines.t: Vermont Magic Street
I arrived at the location of the 'Secret Party' written on the invitation.
Fixer! Over here, over here!
Great, you're following the rule of not calling me by my real name.
Works better for me, too. I don't want to deal with trouble here of all places...
By the way, I don't have an invitation—they won't just kick me out, will they?
Don't worry. Invited guests are allowed to bring one acquaintance.
Mmm, got it. I'm trusting you.
Still... the place we're going to isn't full of weird people like you, right?
Well, we'll find out when we get there.
Vermont Alley
For now, this is the place written on the invitation...
Making us walk through all these winding alleys is strange, isn't it? Is there a reason for it?
Welcome to the [Party of Freedom]. Please present your invitation for identity verification.
Sure, here's the invitation.
And this lady here is my friend.
Invitation verified. Please take these masks and step inside.
Oh, they even give us masks? That works great for me!
By the way, calling the party 'Freedom'... There's something kind of romantic about it.
Passing through a small door and walking down a short flight of stairs, a spacious and elegant ballroom unfolded before us.
Party of Freedom Banquet Hall
Thank you for attending today's party.
First, please use the changing room over here to match today's dress code.
Dress... code?
I dressed up glamourously like I usually do, but is this not enough...?
Ah, that's not it.
Didn't I tell you?
Tell me what?
The dress code here is...
[Nude].
Hehe.
You didn't say anything about that!!!!
But if I told you that, you wouldn't have even had the courage to show up here.
Acting in front of a camera is one thing, but in your daily life, you care way too much about what people think.
That... that might be true, but...
Just think of it as a Day of Freedom. Everyone is naked anyway, so what's the difference?
B-But still...!!!

What are you worrying about when you're wearing a mask right now?
It's a mask equipped with perception-jamming technology, so no one can recognize you anyway.
In other words, you don't need to act like the actress 'Estelle' for anyone here.
...Is this what you think 'true courage' is?
Taking off your clothes in front of others?
I told you, didn't I? You can take your first step toward 'true courage' here.
True courage is something you build up step by step.
And to me, courage is fundamentally the act of being able to reveal yourself.
In that sense, I've got nothing to hide. But what about you?
It kind of makes sense, but then again, maybe it doesn't...
Now, now!! Hurry up and get into the dressing room! The party's going to be over!
W-Woaaah!! I-I'm not mentally prepared yet...!!
After the party ended, the two of us headed home.
Aside from taking off our clothes, the party was actually pretty normal...
Since it started with such an impact, I expected the whole party to be one continuous string of bizarre antics.
Well, that's because only people like that gathered there.
What do you mean, "only people like that"?
How do you know that?
...Wait, don't tell me?
You... this wasn't your first time at that party, was it?! You already seemed to know the dress code was nude, too...!
Calm down. It really was my first time going in person, but I had a pretty good idea of what it was about.
I told you, I'm not an exhibitionist or anything. I was just curious and wanted to check it out.
In the end, you just invited me so you could see me naked!!
I wasn't *just* trying to see you naked.
Don't lie...! What else were you trying to see besides that...?!
That face right there.
Eek!

lines.t: Over here. You got here fast, huh?
Estelle, is it really okay for us to meet in broad daylight like this?
Won't someone see us together?
I don't... mind.
Ignoring people's stares isn't as big of a deal as I thought.
Seems like a pretty big deal to me. You haven't totally gotten over it yet...
S-Shut up. I'm actively practicing right now.
And that day... I was mad that you tricked me, but...
More than anger, it left me with this subtle sense of relief inside.
I don't quite understand what this feeling is yet, so I wanted to ask you.
True courage and true freedom.
...Stop joking around.
I'm serious. It's just that everyone's idea of courage and freedom points in a different direction.
In your case, what binds you is "the eyes of others."
I-Is that so...? I don't think that's all there is to it, though...
Oho... Then what else is there?
...I don't want to admit it, but somehow, that day became a special day inside me.
Ever since I got home, that party keeps replaying in my head...
I've been to tons of parties and there was nothing special about it, so why?
I want to find the answer to that.
And... I want you to help me with it.
How?
I'll invite you too. To a "party" that I host.
What are you talking about?
You'll find out soon enough. Hehehe...
...I have a bad feeling about this.

lines.t: Kinogarten Studio
Over here, {player}.
This is the studio I work at.
Seems a bit small for a movie studio.
The scene we're filming today takes place in a set modeled after a house interior.
So the studio was set up with that kind of vibe.
How do you feel, coming to a film set?
I've been to one before, but there's barely anyone around today.
Is this project pretty small-scale?
It is a small film, but...
It's also a top-secret film.
The scene we're shooting today is a bit... more provocative than usual.
Hmm...
By the way, what about the party? When is that happening?
Standby in 30 minutes!
I've never filmed a scene this explicit in my life.
It's going to be a pretty iconic milestone in my career.
Because it's... my very first... "bed scene" in the truest sense.
Wait, so what about the party...?
Hold on. Did you say a <bouten>bed scene</bouten>?!
Ever since you took me to that party, I've done a lot of thinking about myself.
As my fame grew, the opportunities to show my real self actually shrank.
The more my career built up, the more I felt like I was slowly drowning.
But at that party I went to with you, I was able to break free from that for the first time.
At that party, I wasn't acting as the actress [Estelle]. I just... followed my heart and enjoyed myself as much as I wanted.
And this time... I'm going to do the same.
...So why did you call me here?
I want you to be my co-star for my first bed scene.
Ah, a co-... W-W-What?! All of a sudden?!
Don't worry. Your face won't be shown.
Though your moans might make it in...♡
{player}, how was your first shoot?
Finishing the shoot without a single blooper is pretty amazing, isn't it?
Have you done this a lot before?
I barely did anything... I was too busy being led around.
Acting is way harder than I thought! How do you even do this in daily life—
Ahaha, I told you, you did really well for your first time. No need to put yourself down like that.
Honestly, I think we have great chemistry. Even when mistakes happened, we covered them seamlessly with ad-libs...
...What do you think? How about acting as my partner from now on?
...As long as it doesn't clash with my Fixer work.
